verdict.rationale: FreshBooks' own docs say users can link a bank account and set up automated workflows for bank reconciliation and transaction management, which covers the core bank-feed connection. However, credit-card account linking and a daily automatic transaction import are not explicitly documented. Missing for 10: explicit credit-card account linking, documented daily or recurring automatic transaction import, details of the bank-feed mechanism, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect bank and credit-card accounts so transactions import automatically every day

citations.quote: FreshBooks lets you link your bank account and create automated workflows for bank reconciliation and transaction management
